notes:
PlaneSite 1.6.9:
- The fast GeoTIFF export from 1.6.8 now actually runs when you export from the Export window. 1.6.8 only used it when the compression was left unspecified, and the Export window always names it, so exports still took the old, slow route. Exporting the whole orthomosaic now takes about as long as copying the file, and field exports copy every tile inside the field and only redo the tiles along the edge.
- Exporting in the orthomosaic's own compression (Compact/JPEG for a normal project) adds no extra quality loss. Choosing a different compression or a smaller size still uses the slower route.
